purpose: Persist conversations/messages and optionally generate assistant responses through a configured provider.
prohibited_uses: No consequential autonomous external actions; no claim of production OpenAI enablement; no provider tools or autonomous agent authority through this inventory record.
human_oversight: Human user initiates interaction; provider enablement and deployment remain operator-controlled.
authority_boundary: ASSISTANT_PROVIDER defaults disabled; configured OpenAI path is distinct from the later governed-provider wrapper; production deployment state is not established.
data_classes: conversation text; assistant responses; provider provenance/usage metadata
recovery_fallback: Provider failure preserves persisted user message; isolated persistence/reload behavior is verified.
next_review_trigger: Production deployment; provider/configuration change; material route/tool/retention change

purpose: Gate cost-bearing provider execution through immutable attempt identity, token preflight, exposure quotation, durable reservation, replay protection and role-correct settlement.
prohibited_uses: No automatic retries behind one authorization; no cost-bearing execution without reservation; no claim that ordinary configured assistant traffic uses this wrapper in production.
human_oversight: Budget/authorization policy remains human-governed; retries require separate authorization identity.
authority_boundary: Provider execution fails closed on invalid envelope, unquotable exposure, denied/ambiguous reservation or replay; live budget-binding substrate is absent.
data_classes: provider request envelope; token counts; exposure quote; reservation/telemetry provenance
recovery_fallback: Replay/idempotency controls and settlement recovery are repository/isolated evidence; production recovery not established.
next_review_trigger: Live deployment of budget/provider path; provider/rate-card change; retry/recovery model change

canonical_name: Virtual Employee Foundry substrate and governed runtime
purpose: Provide durable agent identity/profile, capability grants, authorization, execution provenance, recovery, deliberation and a provider-independent fail-closed broker.
prohibited_uses: No production autonomous Virtual Employees; no C3/C4 execution; no external adapter activation without separate authority and controls.
human_oversight: Human authority remains required for consequential grants/decisions; accepted broker is isolated and limited to C0-C2.
authority_boundary: Live Supabase lacks Foundry profile/capability/execution tables and has zero cm_agent rows; repository broker uses deterministic local adapter verification.
data_classes: agent/actor identities; grants; authorization decisions; execution/recovery/deliberation provenance
recovery_fallback: Recovery checkpoints re-enter current authorization/grant/budget checks; live recovery operation not established.
next_review_trigger: Foundry migration/deployment; agent activation; external adapter addition; authority ceiling change

purpose: Coordinate bounded concurrent work claims using leases, opaque tokens and fencing epochs anchored to existing tasks.
prohibited_uses: A lease is not execution authority; no worker/poller or adapter dispatch is authorized by lease ownership alone.
human_oversight: Real work still requires capability, authorization, budget and adapter-specific controls; no autonomous worker is active.
authority_boundary: Kernel is repository/isolated only; live migration history does not contain the work-lease migration.
data_classes: task identifiers; worker identifiers; lease tokens/fencing epochs; significant transition provenance
recovery_fallback: Expiry/reclaim, stale-owner rejection and bounded retry/exhaustion are isolated verified; production crash recovery not established.
next_review_trigger: Worker implementation; live deployment; workload/connection-pool benchmark; retry policy change

canonical_name: Current-runtime budget authority and FinOps controls
purpose: Bind runtime executions to durable budget authority, reservations, usage telemetry and settlement without creating a second monetary ledger.
prohibited_uses: No spending authorization may be inferred from code presence; no production cost-bearing action without effective binding/reservation authority.
human_oversight: Material budget policy and exceptions remain human-governed; paid-provider verification is separately guarded.
authority_boundary: Live Supabase lacks cm_budget_authority_binding and later runtime-budget migrations; repository tests prove isolated behavior only.
data_classes: budget bindings; reservations; usage/settlement provenance; cost metadata
recovery_fallback: Reservation/settlement/idempotency controls exist in repository; production reconciliation/continuity not established.
next_review_trigger: Live budget migration/deployment; pricing change; provider activation; financial authority policy change

canonical_name: Live Supabase base data and PM-ledger platform
purpose: Host the current live comind base schema, PM-ledger migrations and enabled module registry on PostgreSQL 17.11.
prohibited_uses: Do not treat current live schema as Foundry/security-hardened or safe for production VE autonomy; do not infer least privilege from table existence.
human_oversight: Production database mutation requires explicit authority; current GOV lanes use read-only inspection only.
authority_boundary: Only three live migrations are present; 75/79 comind tables lacked RLS in the controlled security snapshot and later Foundry/budget controls are absent.
data_classes: application records; project/PM data; conversation/document/memory-related schema; module metadata
recovery_fallback: No GOV-003 mutation; future hardening requires ordered migration delta, backup/recovery readiness and post-deployment verification.
next_review_trigger: Any live migration/configuration change; Supabase security-advisor change; Data API/grant change; production activation decision

canonical_name: Live memory vector and knowledge schema
purpose: Provide schema and pgvector-capable storage primitives for future memory, embeddings, knowledge graph and document/chunk retrieval.
prohibited_uses: Do not claim active persistent-memory, RAG, vector retrieval or knowledge operation from schema presence alone; do not use ungoverned data for consequential inference.
human_oversight: Population/ingestion and retrieval activation require controlled data authority, provenance, quality and access rules.
authority_boundary: vector extension and relevant tables are live, but cm_memory_node, cm_embedding, cm_kg_node, cm_kg_edge, cm_doc and cm_doc_chunk each had zero rows at observation time.
data_classes: potential memory/document/embedding/knowledge data; no populated corpus observed
recovery_fallback: No active corpus or retrieval path was established by the live observation; rollback/retention behavior remains to be defined before activation.
next_review_trigger: First data ingestion; retrieval activation; embedding/model change; data-class/retention/access change
